text:
maria_sales: Kicking off CatalystGroup POC thread. They want hosted -> dedicated evaluation, plus SCIM + SAML + RBAC ask. Can we list blockers and pricing steps?
ajay_se: quick checklist: 1) SAML metadata exchange 2) SCIM delta behavior and throttle 3) RBAC mapping (Okta groups -> Redwood roles) 4) domain ownership proofing for tenant lock.
linh_eng: + what environment? Are they testing Hosted or Private (VPC/on-prem)? That changes cert rotation/KMS requirements.
sam_platform: They said pilot will run on Dedicated pool for latency guarantees. Pricing question from procurement: monthly committed GPUs vs metered hosted. I can share a draft numbers sheet.
maria_sales: procurement also asked about legal box — can we support SOC2 and will we fill their security questionnaire?
sec_bot: Automated reply: security questionnaire tracker created -> https://redwood.internal/sec-q/survey/CG-1798 :eyes: Please upload completed doc there.
ajay_se: SAML details: ask for IdP metadata and desired binding (SP-initiated vs IdP-initiated). Note cert rotation cadence; we support multiple signing certs for rollover. Example metadata snippet to request:
```xml
<EntityDescriptor entityID="https://catalyst-idp.example.com">...<KeyDescriptor use="signing">...</KeyDescriptor>...</EntityDescriptor>
```
linh_eng: SCIM delta notes: we support PATCH, POST, PUT. Typical delta window is per-minute; rate limits apply. If they plan bulk provisioning, recommend SCIM bulk + backoff. Example minimal PATCH payload:
```json
{"schemas":["urn:ietf:params:scim:api:messages:2.0:PatchOp"], "Operations":[{"op":"replace", "path":"roles", "value":["redwood-admin"]}]}
```
sam_platform: RBAC mapping: we can map directory group names to role slugs. Need to confirm whether they want role-to-permission mapping stored in Redwood or push from Okta on every change. Both supported; pushing from IdP reduces drift.
maria_sales: Domain ownership question from their security team — they want tenant lock so only verified domains can create orgs. What's the UX?
ajay_se: We require DNS TXT verification per domain. For federated login, we can assert domain claim from SAML; we also support admin-only provisioning scoped to domains.
linh_eng: For Dedicated, we can spin a pool in their preferred region, but if they want private control plane (VPC), that adds ~2-3 week onboarding and an enterprise license. Call that out in the SOW.
sam_platform: Action items: (1) maria to collect IdP metadata + SCIM test account, (2) ajay to draft RBAC mapping doc and sample SCIM flows, (3) linh to estimate Dedicated lead time + infra surcharge, (4) sec_bot to attach security questionnaire link.
maria_sales: I'll ping Catalyst for metadata and ask procurement for committed GPU targets. Tentative demo next Tue. @ajay_se can you prepare a 10min RBAC mapping walkthrough? :thumbsup:
ajay_se: Yep, will prep slides and a short mapping table.
linh_eng: I'll pull the Dedicated pricing ranges and edge-case notes for domain lockdown.
sec_bot: Security questionnaire status: not started. Reminder set for 3 days.
maria_sales: thanks team — keeping this thread as source of truth. Any quick replies before EOD?
